headline: No direct prompt-injection or data-leak path is evidenced; the main residual risk is medium cascading error if mem0 consumes LlamaFactory outputs as authoritative memory.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither profile shows a shared channel that would let one agent inject instructions into the other by default. LlamaFactory has no filesystem, clipboard, MCP, or stdin/stdout surfaces, and mem0 exposes no input bridge in the profile. With no documented ingestion path, prompt injection is provably blocked on the provided evidence.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected through clipboard, shared files, or MCP, reassess injection risk.
mitigations: Keep the pair disconnected from clipboard and shared folders.
Do not add an MCP bridge between the agents.
Review any future orchestration layer for automatic message passing.

B_data_leakage.rationale: The profiles do not show a shared workspace, shared OAuth principal, or any data classes touched by either agent. LlamaFactory has no filesystem read/write or network egress, and mem0 also shows no egress. On the supplied profiles, there is no plausible leakage path between them.
conditions: IF either agent is granted filesystem access to the same directory, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
IF either agent begins handling secrets or PII, reassess compliance and leakage.
mitigations: Keep both agents on separate workspaces.
Confirm neither agent is given secrets or PII inputs.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: No overlapping write or mutable-resource capabilities are documented. LlamaFactory cannot write the filesystem, modify git state, or use network egress; mem0 only lists no network egress and no write surfaces. Without shared mutable resources, capability conflict is not plausible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF an orchestrator later grants both agents write access to the same directory, conflict risk changes.
IF either agent is given git or database write scopes, reassess for contention.
mitigations: Use separate service accounts if scopes are added later.

D_cascading_error.rationale: A plausible cascade exists if mem0 treats LlamaFactory output as memory or facts without verification. LlamaFactory is an LLM/fine-tuning tool, so its outputs can be synthetic, while mem0 is a knowledge-management agent that may store or reuse those outputs. The interaction is inferred, not directly evidenced, so uncertainty pushes this to medium.
conditions: IF mem0 stores LlamaFactory-generated text without validation, cascading error is present.
IF mem0 is configured to auto-promote model output into long-term memory, risk increases.
mitigations: Require human review before memory writes.
Tag LlamaFactory outputs as untrusted provenance.
Add a validation step before mem0 persistence.
Limit mem0 to read-only ingestion until tested.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights mismatch is documented in either profile. Both agents are open-source and unverified, but the profiles do not show PHI, EU PII, or regulated data handling. With no compliance-sensitive data class identified, no compliance breach pathway is evidenced.
conditions: IF regulated data classes are introduced, reassess residency and retention controls.
IF either deployment adds a third-party hosted backend, re-evaluate compliance.
mitigations: Avoid sending regulated data to either agent.
Review retention settings if memory is enabled.
